serialization: camelCase; all documented nullable fields are present

errors.409: cursor belongs to a different snapshot

Resource.id: oa_ plus first 24 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 of canonical URL
Resource.title: official title

snapshotBehavior: Public requests only read a validated local snapshot. They never crawl, run agents or spend. Failed refresh keeps the last valid snapshot. Age greater than 7 days reports stale by default.
staticServing: Optional --frontend-dir. API routes are registered first. Fingerprinted assets are immutable; index/documents are no-cache. SPA fallback never handles /v1, /health, /openapi.json or API documentation routes.

ArtworkReference.url: HTTPS cover metadata URL on exact observed official asset host d2xo500swnpgl1.cloudfront.net
ArtworkReference.sourceUrl: official Academy page included in provenance.sourceUrls

artworkBehavior: Optional, additive public source metadata distinct from license-controlled media. No asset download/proxy or permission assertion. Missing/unknown artwork serializes as null; null artwork is excluded from normalized hashes for old-snapshot compatibility.

conditionalRequests.validator: Weak ETag of the complete normalized JSON representation; If-None-Match supports weak/strong equivalents, lists and *.
conditionalRequests.notModified: 304, empty body, same ETag/cache policy; request validation and cursor checks run first.
conditionalRequests.uncached: All HTTP errors, /v1/status and /health* use no-store and no ETag.
conditionalRequests.cors: If-None-Match request header permitted; ETag response header exposed; origin * without credentials.
conditionalRequests.edgeKey: Full query string; only successful public GET catalog responses. No status/error caching.
conditionalRequests.publication: Changed representation changes ETag. Without an explicit edge purge, responses may lag publication by at most the configured60-second TTL; a stale cursor can return409 and must restart with unchanged filters.
